info.name: Lunixi Payment Gateway
info.description: Professional Postman collection for Lunixi payment integrations. Tokens are minted and every request is signed automatically through the local signer helper.

exec: // Runs before EVERY request in this collection:
//   1. keeps a merchant access token fresh, minted by the local signer
//   2. has the local signer sign THIS request: X-Key-Id, X-Date, X-Nonce, X-Signature
//      and, when the request has a body, Digest. Step-up endpoints (create intent,
//      direct 2D/3D, capture) reject an unsigned request with 401.
// The private key never enters Postman. A request with the header
// `X-Lunixi-Skip-Auto-Auth: true` (the signer's own endpoints) is left untouched.
// The gateway checks the signature against the request target it receives (path +
// query, percent-encoded). Resolve {{variables}} here, encode once, and send exactly
// that string, so the signed target and the received target are the same.
// The gateway hashes the JSON it parsed, re-serialised without whitespace. Send the
// body in exactly that form with every {{variable}} already resolved: a body that is
// resolved again at send time ({{$guid}}, {{$timestamp}}) would no longer match Digest.
throw new Error('Request body is not valid JSON after variable resolution: ' + error.message);
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: compactBody, options: requestBody.options });
if (!signerUrl) throw new Error('Missing environment variable: signer_url');
if (err) { throw new Error('Token signer unavailable: ' + err.message); }
throw new Error('Token mint failed: ' + JSON.stringify(json));

throw new Error('Request signing failed: ' + JSON.stringify(signed));

pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'HTTP 401: the access token or the request signature was rejected').to.not.equal(401);

item.name: Payment Links
item.description:
Payment links (`/api/v1/payments/links`): a shareable payment page at `https://pay.lunixi.com/<code>`.

- **API key only.** These routes accept the per-request Ed25519 signature only; the collection signs every gateway request. The key needs the `payment-link:create`, `payment-link:view`, `payment-link:manage` and `payment-link:send` scopes (403 `API_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` otherwise). Keys created before payment links do not have them.
- **The key decides the environment.** A TEST key (`mk_test_…`) creates and sees only TEST links; no money is taken on them.
- **Money is in minor units:** `150000` is 1,500.00 TRY.
- **Idempotency-Key** (8–200 printable ASCII characters) is required on create and send. The same key with the same body returns the stored result.
- **Link images** take three requests: declare the file (`/images`), PUT it to the returned storage URL, confirm it. The PUT goes to the storage host, not the gateway: it is `No Auth` and marked `X-Lunixi-Skip-Auto-Auth`, so neither the access token nor the signature reaches storage. `Set Payment Link Image` then shows the image on the link.
- Create, get, update and the actions store the link in `payment_link_id` and its `rowVersion` in `payment_link_row_version`; update and the actions send that `rowVersion` back as `expectedRowVersion`.

Fulfil orders from the `payment.captured` webhook (its payload carries `paymentLinkId` and `paymentLinkCode`), not from these reads.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description:
Webhook endpoint yönetimi + teslimat operasyonları (DEAD_LETTER, replay).
İmza: `x-lunixi-signature` header'ı virgülle ayrılmış `v2=<hex>` item listesidir — tek şema v2'dir; liste biçimi yalnız secret rotasyonundaki 24h grace penceresi içindir (`v2=<yeni>,v2=<eski>`).
v2 = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${eventId}.${timestamp}.${rawBody}`) — eventId=`x-lunixi-event-id`, timestamp=`x-lunixi-signature-timestamp` header'ının BİREBİR string'i (ISO 8601), rawBody=ham istek gövdesi (parse/re-serialize YOK). Item'ları timing-safe karşılaştırın; HERHANGİ biri eşleşirse geçerli, `v2=` item yoksa REDDEDİN.
Retry: 12 deneme / ~52h (10s→24h, ±%20 jitter) → DEAD_LETTER; replay bütçeyi sıfırlar.

request.description: Webhook imzalama secret'ını Sır Kasası'na yazar. Dönen secret id'yi `secret_id` değişkenine koyun; endpoint kaydında `secretRef` = `vault:{{secret_id}}`.
DEAD_LETTER teslimatı yeniden kuyruğa alır; retry bütçesi sıfırlanır (12 deneme / ~52h).

item.name: Wallet
item.description:
Closed-loop wallet, merchant server-to-server API (`/api/v1/wallet/*`): end users, wallets, transfers, withdrawals, top-ups, payments, QR codes and bulk payouts. One request per route.

**Signing.** Every wallet route is behind `SignatureGuard`: reads included, each request carries the per-request Ed25519 signature (`X-Key-Id`, `X-Date`, `X-Nonce`, `X-Signature`, `Digest` with a body). The collection pre-request script signs every request; nothing to do per request. Unsigned is `401 AUTH_HEADERS_MISSING`. The merchant, its programs and its end users come from the signing key.

**The key needs** the `WALLET_SERVICE` product (403 `PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED` otherwise) and the permission behind each route (403 `WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` otherwise):

| Permission | Routes |
|---|---|
| `wallet:*:read` (`wallet:program:read`, `wallet:enduser:read`, `wallet:operation:read`, `wallet:qr:read`, …) | ping, reads, quotes, QR parse |
| `wallet:program:manage` / `wallet:enduser:manage` (set-up: `wallet:program\|enduser\|limit\|fee:manage`) | collection anchor; end users, wallets and accounts, wallet lookup, deposit instructions, freeze |
| `wallet:operation:intervene` | money inside the wallet: W2W, card and agent top-ups, top-up refund, payments |
| `wallet:bank-payout:operate` | IBAN transfers, bank withdrawals, simulated inbound credit (GROWTH plan) |
| `wallet:qr:manage` | create and revoke QR |
| `wallet:bulk:create` | corporate accounts, employee import and offboard, create and reject bulk payouts |
| `wallet:bulk:approve` | submit, approve, process and retry bulk payouts (the approving key must differ from the creating key) |
| `wallet:enduser:kyc-override` | update the KYC level |

Payment request and collect also need a **wallet terminal bound to the signing key**.

**Bodies.** The gateway rejects an unknown body field with 400 (`forbidNonWhitelisted`); the bodies here contain only fields the gateway accepts. **Amounts are minor units as digit strings**: `"12550"` is 125.50 TRY, never a number or a decimal.

**Idempotency-Key.** Required on the routes that create or move something (the request has the header; 1-128 characters after trimming). It is a fresh `{{$guid}}` per send; to test a replay, pin it to a fixed value and send twice.

**Two-step money.** W2W, IBAN transfer and bank withdrawal are initiate + complete; payment is request + approve. The first step answers `operationId` (payment: `requestId`), `integrityHash`, `nonce` and `otpRequired`; the folder stores them in `wallet_operation_id` (payment: `wallet_payment_operation_id`), `wallet_integrity_hash`, `wallet_nonce`, and the second step sends them back. Complete bodies also carry `operationId` equal to the path id. When `otpRequired` is true, add `"otpCode"` to the second step's body.

**Run order.** Programs (fills `wallet_program_id`) → End users (create, chains the end user, wallet and account) → Wallets & accounts → Deposits (the simulated inbound credit funds the account on a test bank integration) → Corporate → Fees → Transfers W2W → Transfers IBAN → Bank withdrawals → Operations → Top-ups → Payments → QR → Bulk payouts → End-user lifecycle (freeze, last). Before running, set `wallet_destination_wallet_no` (another end user's wallet number), `wallet_business_end_user_id` (a BUSINESS end user), `wallet_rail_id`, `wallet_agent_id` and, for collect, `wallet_payment_code`.

Wallet responses never overwrite `payment_id` or `checkout_token`.

item.name: Programs
item.description: The programs of the signing merchant. Run `List My Programs` first: it fills `wallet_program_id` when it is empty.

request.description:
Checks that the key reaches the wallet: signature, the `WALLET_SERVICE` product (403 `PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED` otherwise) and the wallet permissions.

**Permission:** a manage permission such as `wallet:program:manage` (the wallet's ping sits behind its management scope; a read-only key gets 403 `WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`).
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

The wallet programs of the signing merchant: `{ items, nextCursor }`. Stores the first program's `id` in `wallet_program_id` when that variable is empty; set it yourself to use another program.

**Permission:** `wallet:program:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Sets the end user whose wallet collects the program's merchant payments (`wallet_business_end_user_id`, a BUSINESS end user). Sending no `collectionEndUserId` clears the anchor. `expectedVersion` (the program `version`) guards against a concurrent change.

**Permission:** `wallet:program:manage`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

item.name: End users
item.description: An end user is the person (PERSONAL) or business (BUSINESS) who owns wallets in a program. `Create End User` also opens the default wallet and chains `wallet_end_user_id`, `wallet_id`, `wallet_no` and `wallet_account_id`.

Stores `endUser.id` in `wallet_end_user_id`, the default wallet in `wallet_id` / `wallet_no` and its account in `wallet_account_id`. The phone and `externalCustomerId` identify the person inside the program: change `wallet_phone` and `wallet_external_customer_id` to create another one.

**Permission:** `wallet:enduser:manage`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

End users of the merchant, newest first. Filters: `programId`, `accountType`, `status`, `corporateAccountId`, `merchantCategoryState`; pages with `limit` (1-100) and `cursor`.

**Permission:** `wallet:enduser:read`.

item.name: Transfers W2W
item.description: Wallet to wallet in two steps: initiate reserves the limit and answers `operationId`, `integrityHash`, `nonce` and `otpRequired`; complete commits it. Set `wallet_destination_wallet_no` to the wallet number of another end user first (create one with another `wallet_phone` and copy `defaultWallet.walletNo`).

request.description:
Fee and total for the transfer, without moving money. Its `scheduleVersionId`, sent to initiate, holds that fee. The destination is `destinationWalletNo` or `destinationPhone`.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Step 1 of 2: reserves the limit. Stores `operationId`, `integrityHash` and `nonce` in `wallet_operation_id`, `wallet_integrity_hash`, `wallet_nonce`. With `otpDestination` and `otpChannel` (`EMAIL`, `SMS`, `PUSH`) the end user gets an OTP and the answer has `otpRequired: true`. The source account must belong to `endUserId` (404 `WALLET_NOT_FOUND` otherwise).

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

Step 2 of 2: commits the transfer. Sends back the `operationId`, `integrityHash` and `nonce` the initiate request chained (`wallet_operation_id`, `wallet_integrity_hash`, `wallet_nonce`). `operationId` is in the body too and must equal the id in the path. When the initiate answer has `otpRequired: true`, add `"otpCode": "<code the end user received>"` to the body (6-10 digits); with `stepUpRequired: true` add `"trustedActionToken"`. An empty `otpCode` is a 400, so the field is not in the body by default.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

**Permission:** `wallet:bank-payout:operate` (GROWTH plan).

Step 2 of 2: sends the transfer to the bank. Sends back the `operationId`, `integrityHash` and `nonce` the initiate request chained (`wallet_operation_id`, `wallet_integrity_hash`, `wallet_nonce`). `operationId` is in the body too and must equal the id in the path. An empty `otpCode` is a 400, so the field is not in the body by default.

**Permission:** `wallet:bank-payout:operate` (GROWTH plan).
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

item.name: Operations
item.description: Every money movement is an operation. The requests below read the last operation chained into `wallet_operation_id`.

request.description:
Operations, newest first. Filters: `endUserId`, `walletAccountId`, `destinationWalletAccountId`, `status`, `operationType`; pages with `limit` (1-100) and `cursor`.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

One operation with its status history: `{ operation, history }`.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

The receipt of a completed operation.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

item.name: Top-ups
item.description: Money into the wallet by card or through a cash agent.

request.description:
Starts a card top-up of 1,000.00. Render `checkoutFormContent` (or follow `redirectUrl` / `threeDsHtml`); the account is credited when the card payment completes (`wallet.topup.completed`). Stores `operationId` in `wallet_topup_operation_id`; the answer's `paymentId` is the card payment and is not copied into `payment_id`. The saved-card fields pay with a stored card.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

The top-up in `wallet_topup_operation_id`: `{ operation, history }`.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Refunds a completed card top-up to the card. `approverPrincipal` must differ from `requesterPrincipal` where the program requires two people. A top-up whose card payment has not completed cannot be refunded.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Cash top-up of 500.00 through an agent of the program (`wallet_agent_id`): the agent's float pays the end user's account.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

item.name: Payments
item.description: The end user pays the merchant. The creditor is the **wallet terminal bound to the signing key**: without one, request and collect are 403 `WALLET_TERMINAL_*`. A `businessAccountId` in the body is refused.

request.description:
Asks the buyer (by `buyerWalletNo` or `buyerPhone`) to pay 49.90. The answer's `requestId` is the payment operation: stored in `wallet_payment_operation_id`, with `integrityHash` and `nonce` in `wallet_integrity_hash` / `wallet_nonce`.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

The buyer approves the payment requested above. `buyerEndUserId` names the buyer; the payment must be theirs. When the request answer has `otpRequired: true`, add `"otpCode": "<code the end user received>"` to the body (6-10 digits); with `stepUpRequired: true` add `"trustedActionToken"`. An empty `otpCode` is a 400, so the field is not in the body by default.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

The payment in `wallet_payment_operation_id`: `{ operation, history }`.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Collects with the one-time payment code the buyer shows at the till (`wallet_payment_code`, from the end user's app). One call: the code is used up and the payment is booked.

**Permission:** `wallet:operation:intervene`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

The active acceptance commission schedule of a business (`wallet_business_end_user_id`).

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

item.name: QR
item.description: QR codes to pay a person or the merchant. Static codes carry no amount; dynamic codes require one.

request.description:
Creates a dynamic person-to-person QR for 75.00 that expires in 15 minutes. `qrType`: `P2P_STATIC`, `P2P_DYNAMIC`, `MERCHANT_STATIC`, `MERCHANT_DYNAMIC`. Stores `id` in `wallet_qr_id` and the signed `payload` in `wallet_qr_payload`.

**Permission:** `wallet:qr:manage`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

QR codes. Filters: `programId`, `qrType`, `status`, `targetEndUserId`; pages with `limit` and `cursor`.

**Permission:** `wallet:qr:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

One QR code with its status (`ACTIVE`, `CONSUMED`, `EXPIRED`, `REVOKED`).

**Permission:** `wallet:qr:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

The QR as an **image** (`image/svg+xml` or `image/png`), not the JSON envelope; an error is still JSON. `format`: `svg` (default) or `png`; `scale` 1-20.

**Permission:** `wallet:qr:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Decodes a scanned QR payload: type, target, amount, currency, validity.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Revokes the QR in `wallet_qr_id`; it cannot be paid any more.

**Permission:** `wallet:qr:manage`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

item.name: Bulk payouts
item.description: Many payouts from one source account, with maker-checker: one key creates and submits (it needs `wallet:bulk:create` and, for submit, `wallet:bulk:approve`), a **different key** with `wallet:bulk:approve` approves (the approver is the signing key; the creating key cannot approve: `WALLET_FOUR_EYES_VIOLATION`). Switch to the approver key's environment before `Approve` (`key_id` and its private key or signer; empty `access_token` so a new token is minted).

request.description:
Creates a DRAFT batch. Item fields: `targetType` (`WALLET` or `IBAN`), `targetRef` (wallet number or IBAN), `amount`, `beneficiaryName`. For a corporate account the source must be an account of its owner. Stores `batch.id` in `wallet_bulk_batch_id`.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:create`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).

Batches. Filters: `programId`, `status`; `limit` 1-100.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

The batch with its counters (`itemCount`, `completedCount`, `failedCount`, `pendingCount`) and hold amounts.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Items of the batch with their result. Filters: `status`; `limit` 1-1000.

**Permission:** `wallet:*:read`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Maker: DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:approve`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Checker: approves the batch (`approve: false` declines it with `reason`). **Sign with a different key** than the one that created and submitted the batch.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:approve`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Pays the approved items. A large batch is processed in chunks: `hasMore: true` means items are left; call again or let the worker continue.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:approve`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

exec: pm.test('Retry Failed Bulk Payout Items: 2xx', function () {

request.description:
Retries the failed items of a processed batch.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:approve`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

Rejects a batch that is waiting for approval. It is the alternative to `Approve`: after the batch above was approved and processed this answers 409.

**Permission:** `wallet:bulk:create`.
**Idempotency-Key:** not used.

item.name: End-user lifecycle
item.description: Last on purpose: a frozen end user cannot move money, and the merchant API has no unfreeze.

request.description:
Freezes the end user in `wallet_end_user_id`: their wallets stop moving money. There is no unfreeze route on the merchant API.

**Permission:** `wallet:enduser:manage`.
**Idempotency-Key:** required (a fresh one per send; pin it to replay).
